verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents JumpCloud Go as a hardware-protected, phishing-resistant passwordless login method for web resources, and lists JumpCloud Protect push, biometrics, and hardware keys among supported authentication methods. That covers the core of the story, but the passwordless claim is limited to users on managed devices, and the evidence is marketing-level only. Missing for 10: explicit passkey/FIDO2 passwordless support beyond managed devices, evidence that the authenticator-app push or biometric methods work as a primary passwordless factor rather than only as MFA, in-depth setup docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
